a7e621023998.name: Wedja Restaurant
a7e621023998.description: Restaurant in Mas with a garden of lotuses and illuminated jungle in the evening.
a7e621023998.recommendation: Come at sunset for the garden. The food may disappoint.

a4943079cfd1.name: Tis Cafe
a4943079cfd1.description: A cafe with a swimming pool opposite the Tegallalang rice terraces.

48055e1a17ac.name: Sari Timbul
48055e1a17ac.description: Art park with wooden sculptures at a glass factory. Sebatu, Tegallalang.

4c41bd8bc6a4.name: Copenhagen
4c41bd8bc6a4.description: Scandinavian style cafes and bakeries. Cafe at Jl Padang Linjong, bakeries in Pererenan and Seseh.
4c41bd8bc6a4.recommendation: Try the tasting breakfast set, there is a queue in the morning. Open from 6:00.

35fd1227db4a.name: Elements
35fd1227db4a.description: Massage studio next to Meat Emporium.

5dde17bd57bb.name: Braud Artisan Bakery
5dde17bd57bb.description: Industrial style bakery, Seminyak and Uluwatu. From 8:00.
5dde17bd57bb.recommendation: Sourdough bread, eclair with raspberries and roses.

fd68be6969b8.name: Suka Espresso
fd68be6969b8.recommendation: There is often a queue, it is better to arrive early.

12d5e594681c.name: Chela
12d5e594681c.description: Chalet-style restaurant-bar, seating on the floor at low tables. Bingin.

7fc19f54c43c.name: Rock Bar
7fc19f54c43c.description: Clifftop bar at the AYANA hotel in Jimbaran.
7fc19f54c43c.recommendation: Arrive an hour before sunset. Beachwear is not allowed.

bb24981e2abe.name: Pantai Karang
bb24981e2abe.description: Calm beach behind the reef in Sanur.

c9541f4a7d1d.name: Nuanu Creative City
c9541f4a7d1d.description: A 44-hectare site with art installations, restaurants and events.
c9541f4a7d1d.recommendation: Allow half a day for a visit including Lumeira.

e5d14b8211af.name: Leke Leke
e5d14b8211af.recommendation: Come early, as visitors gather quickly at the waterfall.

28d6660a7f5e.name: Akasa Specialty Coffee
28d6660a7f5e.description: Cafe in Kintamani overlooking Mount Batur.
28d6660a7f5e.recommendation: Opens at 05:30 for sunrise. Fog can obscure the volcano.

283052dcfb09.name: Diamond Beach
283052dcfb09.description: Beach in the east of Nusa Penida under high cliffs.
